reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports compliance: §5 (p0023) sets fees via revenue sharing per Exhibit with no obligation for Customer to extend Kubient terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers.
§1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves Customer's right to use other agents or sell Inventory to third parties, reinforcing that no MFN burden is imposed on Customer.
No Vendor-granted MFN in Customer's favour exists that would need to be preserved, so the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is met and no negotiation issue should be raised.
